leads.name: com.akuleshov7:ktoml-core
leads.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases
leads.api_lead: TomlParser(TomlInputConfig()).parseString(String) -> TomlFile node tree (ktoml-core-jvm; Kotlin value class)
leads.evidence: ktoml-core-jvm 0.7.1 with kotlin-stdlib 2.2.0, kotlinx-serialization-core-jvm 1.9.0 and kotlinx-datetime-jvm 0.7.1 parses both controls into its node tree: TomlKeyValuePrimitive values are TomlLong (hex/octal/binary/underscored decoded), TomlDouble (1e3 -> 1000.0), TomlBasicString/TomlLiteralString (escapes and the line-ending backslash decoded), TomlBoolean and TomlDateTime whose content is kotlin.time.Instant (offset), kotlinx.datetime.LocalDateTime, LocalDate or LocalTime, so the four kinds stay distinct; tables, dotted keys and arrays of tables appear as TomlTable/TomlArrayOfTablesElement nodes. No typed-tree harness was built: the parser entry point is a Kotlin inline value class (TomlParser.parseString compiles to the static parseString-impl), which plain Java can reach only by reflection, and the node tree needs a Kotlin-aware walker; not done in this round.
